reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**, from *"Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth"* (North team digest, 5 Oct 2025). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. At the Eau Claire yard, drivers on the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14–18 weren't getting their bay assignments by text when they checked in. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the problem was fixed on 5 Oct. The same note also says to archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
2. **#4419**, from *"Moss: North cheat sheet"* (North team digest, undated). Thea opened it because the gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 during the third shift. The note says it was escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing.

What I left out:
- **#4409, #4412 and FR-882** in Moss's Central handoffs digest (2 Jan 2026) are for Pree's dealer account and Marrow Agrisupply, not QFL.
- Moss's 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and 23 Mar 2026 renewal note mention QFL but don't include any ticket numbers.
- Moss's North cheat sheet warns not to mix QFL up with **Quarendon Freightways**, which isn't a customer. Marcus has a competitive-intel note on that company, so watch for the near-identical name.

There's also a QFL incident channel, but you're not a member, so I didn't look at it. Dana Okafor or Ilse Varga could tell you if there are other ticket numbers in it.
